subtitle: Where more projects go
notes:
Went to work listening to the tail end of the epic length conversation between DHH and Lex Friedman. I am building things and getting into a delirious state.
I was allowed to use Astra until 3pm, suffering from withdrawal.

ideas.title: Github Repository
ideas.tagline: Plain boring, which is to say low friction
ideas.description: A repository with nice, publicly hosted project. A template repository where all the other projects are listed, presented and served as a static site. Everything runs in git

ideas.title: A 5 Idea Website
ideas.description: I got this idea from a book I read a few years ago by James Altucher from Quora (RIP). I did this for a while in a notebook, but it was a great way to get creative. Never implemented one, so this is going to be it. How about one every day?

process_steps.desc: Then I asked Antigravity to produce this with MCP server connection, modern python and my preferred stack (Fast API + Flask + UV + testing). It one shot the prompt, I had to delete the 4 demo days from the DB. It was really cool.

process_steps.title: Step 7
process_steps.desc: I cheated a bit, because I was going to do this anyways, and came up with 4 additional ideas and the theme.

what_rocked: One shot. 15% of a pro subscription 5 hourly quota used for it.
Stitch MCP server is kind of magical.
what_broke: Stitch is really decent at brainstorming, but man it is not good at picking up intent until it's spelled out.

# Implementation Recap: 5 Ideas Daily Showcase & Radical Memphis Pop Engine > **Shipped In:** ~1.5 hours  |  **Architecture:** FastAPI + Flask Admin + Stdlib SQLite  |  **Design:** Radical Memphis Pop Neo-Brutalism  |  **Live Site:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/) --- ## 1. Genesis & Problem Framing ### Initial Spark ```text "initialise a modern python project with uv, python 3.14, flask, fastapi, good test suite, and an agents file for this project. We are building a website based on the Stitch project 5 Ideas Daily Showcase. For now the content that you see in the designs is a demo, so I want some way of controlling it via an admin panel. The most important thing is to create this as a general purpose design system I can render custom content with... Each day is associated with a date, and can be selected from a calendar (biggest view). The middle view is the scroll of ideas day by day with flexible links... I also want a skill which generates a presentable summary of the process..." ``` ### Key Requirements Delivered 1. **Daily Cadence Model:** 5 morning idea sparks per day, with exactly 1 prototype built before sundown. 2. **Preference Ranking:** Front page greets visitors with top-ranked implementations ordered by personal preference. 3. **Calendar View (The Biggest View):** Full monthly grid with date navigation, idea pips, and day deep-dives. 4. **Day-By-Day Stream (The Middle View):** Continuous feed with flexible embedded renderers for WebApps, Poetry zines, 8-bit chiptune songs, vector posters, and widgets. 5. **Flask Admin (`/admin`):** Full CRUD content management and one-click ranking reorder. 6. **General-Purpose Design System:** Radical Memphis Pop tokens, 3px/4px black ink borders, zero-blur hard offset shadows, and component gallery at `/design-system`. 7. **CI/CD & Public Hosting:** Automated GitHub Pages deployment pipeline via GitHub Actions. --- ## 2. Human + AI Interaction Footprint - **Human Turns:** 5 iterations - **Execution Trajectory:** 271 agent steps - **Files Created:** 26 source files (App, Admin, DB, Templates, CSS, Tests, Workflows, Skills) - **Test Suite:** 22 passing tests in `0.55s` ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Stitch Design System
(Radical Memphis Pop)"] --> B["Python 3.14 / uv
Runtime Setup"] B --> C["Stdlib SQLite DB
(Days, Ideas, Impls)"] C --> D["FastAPI Public Views
+ Swagger API"] C --> E["Flask Admin
(/admin via WSGI)"] D --> F["Interactive WebApp
(NeonDJ Turntable)"] D --> G["GitHub Pages CI/CD
(Live Global CDN)"] ``` --- ## 3. Architecture & Build Milestones ### Step 1: Zero-Bloat Data Layer (`db.py`) - Python standard library `sqlite3` in WAL mode with enforced foreign keys. - Relational schema linking `days` (1) ➔ `ideas` (5) ➔ `implementations` (1), indexed by `rank ASC`. - Seeded with 4 canonical days spanning diverse media types (Webapp, Poetry, SVG Poster, 8-bit Chiptune). ### Step 2: Hybrid ASGI/WSGI Web Architecture (`app.py` + `admin.py`) - **FastAPI (ASGI):** Powers high-speed public page rendering, JSON endpoints, and Swagger UI at `/docs`. - **Flask (WSGI):** Cleanly mounted at `/admin` via Starlette `WSGIMiddleware`, handling form submissions, sessions, flash messages, and ranking reorders. ### Step 3: Radical Memphis Pop Design System (`style.css` + Tailwind CDN) - Strict adherence to 90s MTV neo-brutalist physics: - Solid `#1c1b1b` strokes (`3px` / `4px`). - Mechanical hard offset drop-shadows (`4px 4px 0px #1c1b1b` to `8px 8px 0px #1c1b1b`). - Active button physics: translation `translate(4px, 4px)` with shadow collapse on click. - Saturated palette: Radical Magenta (`#b40065`), Electric Cyan (`#00e5ff`), Sunshine Yellow (`#fae100`), Acid Lime (`#39ff14`). ### Step 4: The 4 Core Views - **Top Picks Showcase (`/`):** Hall of Fame leaderboard and latest daily drop. - **Calendar Navigator (`/calendar`):** Interactive monthly matrix with streak badges. - **Stream Feed (`/stream`):** Chronological timeline with polymorphic media renderers. - **NeonDJ WebApp (`/interactive/neondj`):** Live dual-vinyl scratch deck with Web Audio synthesis and 7-band Memphis graphic EQ. ### Step 5: Test Suite & CI/CD Deployment - Full pytest suite (`test_db.py`, `test_api.py`, `test_admin.py`) covering all CRUD, ranking logic, and view rendering. - GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`) automating test execution and static site generation for GitHub Pages. --- ## 4. Retrospective (What Rocked vs What Broke) ### What Rocked 1. **Ponytail Ladder Efficiency:** Using stdlib `sqlite3` eliminated hundreds of lines of ORM boilerplate and database connection pooling headaches. 2. **Native Web Audio API:** The NeonDJ prototype delivers zero-latency turntable scratching and 8-bit FM synthesis without loading a single megabyte of external audio assets. 3. **Sub-Second Test Velocity:** The entire 22-test suite completes in `0.55s`, making test-driven development instantaneous. ### What Broke & How It Was Resolved 1. **CPython 3.14 Alpha PyO3 Binary Incompatibility:** - *Issue:* Python 3.14 alpha 6 (`cpython-3.14.0a6`) had an internal Rust/PyO3 ABI mismatch in `pydantic-core` causing a segmentation fault during schema serialization. - *Fix:* Configured `pyproject.toml` with `requires-python = ">=3.13"`, synced the local environment to Python 3.13.3 for 100% stability, while maintaining forward compatibility for Python 3.14 final. 2. **Starlette TemplateResponse API Shift:** - *Issue:* Modern Starlette swapped parameter order in `TemplateResponse`, interpreting dictionary context as template name. - *Fix:* Transitioned all calls to explicit keyword arguments (`request=request, name=..., context=...`). 3. **Secret Key Safeguard:** - *Issue:* `mcp_config.json` contained an active Google API key before pushing to GitHub. - *Fix:* Added `mcp_config.json` and `*.db` to `.gitignore` before creating the public repository. --- ## 5. Public Links & Resources - **GitHub Repository:** [github.com/LukaszDygon/5-ideas](https://github.com/LukaszDygon/5-ideas) - **Live Showcase:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/) - **Calendar View:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/calendar/](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/calendar/) - **Stream Feed:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/stream/](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/stream/) - **Design System Sandbox:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/design-system/](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/design-system/) - **NeonDJ Prototype:** [lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/interactive/neondj/](https://lukaszdygon.github.io/5-ideas/interactive/neondj/)

ideas.title: A personal project website
ideas.description: I've done this one before - a website that serves as a curated space for free form posting of project. It makes everything seem like it needs curation and ultimately makes for better content, and more deliberate work.

ideas.title: Idea journal
ideas.description: I've got a spare Moleskine notebook, embossed with my name. I've been reading (listening to Audible) the Overstory and one of the characters puts his Computer Programming ideas in a notebook. Very old school. Could be a throwback.

ideas.title: Social Media Account
ideas.description: I don't go for social media posting very often. Partly because I don't want my work to somehow become someone else's intellectual property. But if it's for fun and my friends don't have to download a website, and people who can't download websites can still discover me...
